title: Planar kernel whole-layer fold is not render-faithful on complex multi-overlap clusters (foldShapeIntoLayer / planarShapeToShape)
description:
FINDING from QA verify of tasks 1327/1328/1329 (HEAD 2cfa30e). The 1329 cull fix is CORRECT and bounded (verified: cull partition == brute-force transitive closure and cull merged shape == direct fold of that cluster, 0/400 trials; sparse 400-fill stroke-touches-1 folds in 0.65ms keeping 396 untouched; Magnet.fla imports cleanly, densest shape 1133 paths intact; a merge onto a synthetic 1078-fill dense layer is 4.05ms). This task is a SEPARATE, PRE-EXISTING kernel bug surfaced during that verification, NOT a regression from 1327/1328/1329.

PROBLEM: engine/planar/merge.ts foldShapeIntoLayer() folds N shapes through ONE arrangement (buildArrangementFromShapes) then reads back via planarShapeToShape(). On complex clusters (>=7 mutually-overlapping solid fills with a same-color island in the cluster) the read-back shape, when re-rendered, does NOT reproduce the ground-truth layered render of the same shapes.

REPRO (planar-merge.test.ts style helpers, all x=y=0 offsets, rects [x..x+w,y..y+h]):
  existing (bottom->top): e0[12..28,11..20]BLUE e1[37..66,24..56]GREEN e2[42..63,35..67]YEL e3[7..39,16..51]YEL e4[45..58,10..36]BLUE e5[41..68,10..43]RED e6[43..55,15..27]GREEN
  incoming: s[26..55,36..52]GREEN
  ground-truth render of [existing..., incoming] -> GREEN=691 ... ; planarMergeCommit/foldShapeIntoLayer result re-rendered -> GREEN=547. Δ=144 leaked into other colors.
  Minimal variant: a green cluster + yellow over it + a DISJOINT same-color green island, folded whole-layer: GREEN 643->503, YELLOW 1336->1476 (a disjoint blue island does NOT trigger it). The bug is in the kernel/read-back, not the cull.

IMPACT:
  (1) PRODUCT: merge-on-commit (Shell draw / agent / paste / JSFL, all routed via commitShapeToTimeline in 1328) can VISIBLY alter artwork when the incoming stroke joins a large interacting cluster (the cull rightly folds the whole transitive closure, then the kernel read-back mis-resolves it). Likely visible on dense traced-bitmap art when a new stroke bridges many fills.
  (2) TEST: the 1329 fuzz guard (planar-merge.test.ts 'randomized: culled commit == full whole-layer rebuild') uses foldShapeIntoLayer as its ORACLE and merge.ts asserts in comments the cull is 'geometrically IDENTICAL to the full whole-layer rebuild for ALL inputs'. Since the full rebuild is itself unfaithful, that oracle is unsound — culled==full does NOT prove culled==correct. The guard happens to pass only because its small field/seed never hits a divergent cluster. Recommend changing the fuzz oracle to a GROUND-TRUTH raster/arrangement render of [existing..., incoming] (a 500-trial ground-truth comparison found 6 divergences; all were large single clusters where untouched=[], i.e. pure kernel fold, confirming the cull is not implicated).

FILES: packages/core/src/engine/planar/merge.ts (foldShapeIntoLayer ~187), packages/core/src/engine/planar/query.ts (planarShapeToShape read-back), buildArrangementFromShapes in build.ts. Suspect same-color face-fill resolution / island winding in read-back. Related kernel tasks: 1318, 1325.
